name: Bellquanto's Curse
source:
A reimagining of Rapunzel, except there are two princesses locked in the tower, each with a different idea of how to handle the so-called "prince" who lurks outside.

[From [url=https://arkicade.itch.io/bellquantos-curse]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
重新想象的长发公主，除了有两位公主被锁在塔里，每个人对于如何对付潜伏在塔外的所谓“王子”都有不同的想法。

[来自[url=https://arkicade.itch.io/bellquantos-curse]Itch.io[/url]]
